synthesis.climate_context: Insufficient local data — recommend manual research
synthesis.building_stock: The only Werribee-specific door details in the returned records are a job for three doors where "door is wood and frame is metal" and another where "the current ones are pretty old and don't fit new locks" (both airtasker.com Werribee VIC listings), while thesmartlockshop.com.au lists Werribee in its West service area and pitches to "a house, townhouse, apartment, or managing an Airbnb or retail property" — so a writer should lead on checking door leaf material, frame material and legacy lock cutouts before a retrofit smart deadbolt is promised to fit, and should not assume a single dominant dwelling type.
synthesis.demographic_skew: The returned records show Werribee demand arriving mostly as install-only labour from residents who have already bought the hardware themselves — one airtasker.com Werribee listing has the locks "bought already", another names an ULTRALOQ 5-in-1 U-Bolt WiFi deadbolt and a third an eufy "C33" smart lever lock — alongside short-stay/Airbnb and retail operators named by thesmartlockshop.com.au for the West area that includes Werribee; census-style demographics are not evidenced in the results.
common_concerns: Whether a smart lock the customer has already purchased will actually fit and be installed — the two airtasker.com Werribee VIC listings are install-only requests naming specific owner-supplied models (ULTRALOQ 5-in-1 Keyless Entry / U-Bolt WiFi deadbolt, and an eufy smart lever door lock "C33" for the main entry door).
Whether a smart lock can be fitted to a timber door hung in a metal frame — the Werribee airtasker.com lock-installation listing specifies "door is wood and frame is metal" across three doors.

Whether old existing hardware can be replaced at all, since a Werribee airtasker.com listing reports "the current ones are pretty old and don't fit new locks" — residents want to know if the door itself needs modification.

Whether the installer configures the lock as well as fitting it — locksmithservicewerribee.com.au advertises that it will "install and configure the latest smart locks for homes and businesses", indicating app/WiFi setup is a live buyer question, not just mechanical fitting.
